name: Satyarth Mishra
intro: I turn ideas into intelligent products—connecting machine learning, thoughtful interfaces and visual storytelling.
bio: I’m a Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence student at GLA University, based in Greater Noida. My work moves between computer vision, edge AI, digital products and visual design. I like following an idea all the way through: understanding the problem, building the system, designing the interface and making it clear enough for someone else to use.
education: B.Tech · Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence · GLA University · 2025–2029
availability: Let’s talk AI, products and creative collaborations.
